item.title: The Worst GTA Game Is One Rockstar Could Never Make Today
item.description: GTA Advance is an odd game. It's terrible in some ways, yet also not as bad as its reputation suggests. It's also an essential part of Rockstar history. This was Rockstar at a stage of uncertainty. The essence of the Grand Theft Auto franchise was still in flux, and the studio had yet to firmly decide on what, exactly, made a GTA game . GTA Advance has its strong points, but the most important thing about it is how it gave Rockstar (via developer Digital Eclipse) a chance to see where the series could fall short. It's a necessary bad game that paved the way for better ones — and the kind of essential failure the games industry can't tolerate anymore.

item.title: Activision Apologizes for 'Modern Warfare 4' Footage After Backlash
item.description: Activision has apologized after including real footage of a deadly 2022 incident in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , confirming that the footage will be completely removed in a forthcoming update following backlash from victims' families. The latest Call of Duty game included snippets of footage from the Seoul Halloween crowd crush, during which more than 150 people were killed in the Itaewon neighborhood of Seoul, South Korea.

item.title: All Esper locations in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.description: Final Fantasy Resonance 's Espers give Fina an extra edge in combat, or sometimes they're just convenient decoys to bait the enemy into attacking them and not your party. However you use them, Espers are definitely worth the MP it costs to summon them. You have to put in some extra work to obtain them, though. Espers are tucked away in different spots around Resonance 's world, and you have to find and often fight them before Fina can use their powers.

item.title: Before 'Crystal Lake', Bryan Fuller Created an Overlooked Fantasy Series You Can Watch for Free
item.description: Bryan Fuller is a master of mixing horror, fantasy, and black comedy. Before Crystal Lake , the Friday the 13th prequel whose premiere shares a story credit between Fuller and showrunner Brad Caleb Kane, Fuller became best known for bringing another iconic killer to television in Hannibal . But his fascination with death has also produced stories that are more quirky than terrifying.

item.title: Every Free Game You Can Keep on Steam, Epic and PS Plus This Week (Oct 30–Nov 5)
item.description: The weekend is here, so it's time to unwind and do some gaming. Phantom Blade Zero has taken the world by storm with its incredibly successful launch. It captured the interest of critics and gamers alike, racking up extraordinary reviews and quickly reaching the top of the charts on Steam. But hey, Wuxia soulslike RPGs aren't everyone's cup of tea. If you're looking for something to keep you busy while you wait for Grand Theft Auto 6 to come out or just want a game to keep you busy for the weekend, we've got you covered.

item.title: 5 new books to read this weekend (October 30-November 1)
item.description: As we move through an era where cinema is popping off, giving us great films that everyone is talking about like You Can See Everything and The Devils , it can't be forgotten that this week is also a great one for new book releases from the past year. A new Sarah J. Maas book, a horror occult book by a Nebula-winning author, and the first novel from Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma director Jane Schoenbrun. We would say it's a good week to pick up a book, but honestly, it's always a good time to read.

item.title: How to open the Crimson Manor in Phantom Blade Zero
item.description: The Crimson Manor is a mysterious location in Phantom Blade Zero that you discover after riding a suspicious elevator in the Weeping Creek Valley . Although you can visit it in the first few hours of the game, the doors to the somber building won't budge until you have a unique key that fits the puppet-shaped lock. Unlocking the manor is a secondary mission, but one that helps you learn more about a central character and achieve the game's true ending.
